scheme_name: Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
other_conditions: The tubewell must be registered with the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
Applicant must hold at least 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell and have ownership of the land for at least 2 years with a clear title deed in their name.
The 1.5‑acre land holding may belong to the applicant, the spouse, or a member of a joint/undivided family.
Applicants who have availed the subsidy for the same purpose within the last 5 years are ineligible.
The applicant must not convert the land for any non‑agricultural purpose for 10 years from the date of tubewell construction and must execute a bond accordingly.
benefits_summary: 90% subsidy up to ₹60,000 per tubewell for installation of submersible or centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories.
